Indikator outstanding diambil dari kolom progres detail, yaitu jmldo dan/atau statusdo; logika aman yang dipakai adalah qty order lebih besar daripada qty yang sudah menjadi DO dengan IFNULL agar null dianggap 0. queries.name: SO Belum Menjadi DO
queries.purpose: Menampilkan item sales order yang qty-nya belum seluruhnya diproses menjadi delivery order.
queries.query: SELECT so.sonotransaksi AS nomor_so, so.sotgl AS tanggal_so, c.knama AS nama_customer, i.bkode AS kode_barang, sod.namabarang AS nama_barang, sod.satuanbarang AS satuan_barang, sod.jmlbarang AS qty_so, IFNULL(sod.jmldo, 0) AS qty_do, (sod.jmlbarang - IFNULL(sod.jmldo, 0)) AS qty_belum_do, sod.statusdo AS status_do, sod.catatan AS catatan_detail FROM m5_so_detail sod INNER JOIN m5_so so ON sod.idso = so.soid LEFT JOIN m1_contact c ON so.socustomer = c.kid AND c.kaktif = 1 LEFT JOIN m1_item i ON sod.idbarang = i.bid AND i.baktif = 1 WHERE so.soisclose = 0 AND sod.isclose = 0 AND sod.jmlbarang > IFNULL(sod.jmldo, 0) ORDER BY qty_belum_do DESC, so.sotgl DESC, so.sonotransaksi ASC

queries.name: DO Belum Menjadi DR
queries.purpose: Menampilkan item delivery order yang qty-nya belum seluruhnya diproses menjadi delivery report.
queries.query: SELECT doo.donotransaksi AS nomor_do, doo.dotgl AS tanggal_do, c.knama AS nama_customer, i.bkode AS kode_barang, dod.namabarang AS nama_barang, dod.satuanbarang AS satuan_barang, dod.jmlbarang AS qty_do, IFNULL(dod.jmldr, 0) AS qty_dr, (dod.jmlbarang - IFNULL(dod.jmldr, 0)) AS qty_belum_dr, dod.statusdr AS status_dr, dod.catatan AS catatan_detail FROM m5_do_detail dod INNER JOIN m5_do doo ON dod.iddo = doo.doid LEFT JOIN m1_contact c ON doo.docustomer = c.kid AND c.kaktif = 1 LEFT JOIN m1_item i ON dod.idbarang = i.bid AND i.baktif = 1 WHERE doo.doisclose = 0 AND dod.jmlbarang > IFNULL(dod.jmldr, 0) ORDER BY qty_belum_dr DESC, doo.dotgl DESC, doo.donotransaksi ASC

queries.query: SELECT dr.drnotransaksi AS nomor_dr, dr.drtgl AS tanggal_dr, c.knama AS nama_customer, i.bkode AS kode_barang, drd.namabarang AS nama_barang, drd.satuanbarang AS satuan_barang, drd.jmlbarang AS qty_dr, IFNULL(drd.jmlsi, 0) AS qty_invoice, (drd.jmlbarang - IFNULL(drd.jmlsi, 0)) AS qty_belum_invoice, drd.statussi AS status_invoice, drd.catatan AS catatan_detail FROM m5_dr_detail drd INNER JOIN m5_dr dr ON drd.iddr = dr.drid LEFT JOIN m1_contact c ON dr.drcustomer = c.kid AND c.kaktif = 1 LEFT JOIN m1_item i ON drd.idbarang = i.bid AND i.baktif = 1 WHERE drd.jmlbarang > IFNULL(drd.jmlsi, 0) ORDER BY qty_belum_invoice DESC, dr.drtgl DESC, dr.drnotransaksi ASC

queries.name: Top Margin Bersih Customer
queries.purpose: Menampilkan customer dengan margin bersih tertinggi berdasarkan invoice penjualan, biaya invoice, retur, dan diskon.
queries.query:
SELECT
  x.customer_id,
  x.customer_code,
  x.customer_name,
  x.total_sales_before_discount,
  x.total_discount,
  x.net_sales_after_discount,
  x.total_invoice_cost,
  x.total_sales_return,
  (x.net_sales_after_discount - x.total_invoice_cost - x.total_sales_return) AS net_margin
FROM (
  SELECT
    c.kid AS customer_id,
    c.kkode AS customer_code,
    c.knama AS customer_name,
    SUM(sd.jmlbarang * sd.harga) AS total_sales_before_discount,
    SUM(sd.jmldiskon) AS total_discount,
    SUM((sd.jmlbarang * sd.harga) - sd.jmldiskon) AS net_sales_after_discount,
    COALESCE(SUM(DISTINCT sic.total_invoice_cost_marker), 0) AS total_invoice_cost,
    COALESCE(sr.total_sales_return, 0) AS total_sales_return
  FROM m5_si si
  INNER JOIN m5_si_detail sd
    ON sd.idsi = si.siid
  INNER JOIN m1_contact c
    ON si.sicustomer = c.kid
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      sc.idsi,
      SUM(sc.jumlah) AS total_invoice_cost,
      SUM(sc.jumlah) AS total_invoice_cost_marker
    FROM m5_si_cost sc
    GROUP BY sc.idsi
  ) sic
    ON sic.idsi = si.siid
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      s.srcustomer,
      SUM(s.srtotaltransaksi) AS total_sales_return
    FROM m5_sr s
    GROUP BY s.srcustomer
  ) sr
    ON sr.srcustomer = c.kid
  WHERE si.siisclose = 0
    AND sd.isclose = 0
    AND c.kaktif = 1
  GROUP BY
    c.kid,
    c.kkode,
    c.knama,
    sr.total_sales_return
) x
ORDER BY net_margin DESC
LIMIT 10

queries.name: Bottom Margin Bersih Customer
queries.purpose: Menampilkan customer dengan margin bersih terendah berdasarkan invoice penjualan, biaya invoice, retur, dan diskon.
queries.query:
SELECT
  x.customer_id,
  x.customer_code,
  x.customer_name,
  x.total_sales_before_discount,
  x.total_discount,
  x.net_sales_after_discount,
  x.total_invoice_cost,
  x.total_sales_return,
  (x.net_sales_after_discount - x.total_invoice_cost - x.total_sales_return) AS net_margin
FROM (
  SELECT
    c.kid AS customer_id,
    c.kkode AS customer_code,
    c.knama AS customer_name,
    SUM(sd.jmlbarang * sd.harga) AS total_sales_before_discount,
    SUM(sd.jmldiskon) AS total_discount,
    SUM((sd.jmlbarang * sd.harga) - sd.jmldiskon) AS net_sales_after_discount,
    COALESCE(SUM(DISTINCT sic.total_invoice_cost_marker), 0) AS total_invoice_cost,
    COALESCE(sr.total_sales_return, 0) AS total_sales_return
  FROM m5_si si
  INNER JOIN m5_si_detail sd
    ON sd.idsi = si.siid
  INNER JOIN m1_contact c
    ON si.sicustomer = c.kid
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      sc.idsi,
      SUM(sc.jumlah) AS total_invoice_cost,
      SUM(sc.jumlah) AS total_invoice_cost_marker
    FROM m5_si_cost sc
    GROUP BY sc.idsi
  ) sic
    ON sic.idsi = si.siid
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      s.srcustomer,
      SUM(s.srtotaltransaksi) AS total_sales_return
    FROM m5_sr s
    GROUP BY s.srcustomer
  ) sr
    ON sr.srcustomer = c.kid
  WHERE si.siisclose = 0
    AND sd.isclose = 0
    AND c.kaktif = 1
  GROUP BY
    c.kid,
    c.kkode,
    c.knama,
    sr.total_sales_return
) x
ORDER BY net_margin ASC
LIMIT 10
